spec.title: HashiStack / Remote Dev Workspaces
spec.description: Developer workspaces (Nomad jobs <developer>-devpod-<seed> in each developer's namespace) and the planes they depend on: resource use against reservations, SSH (sm-jump bastion) and web (Traefik) access, onboarding portal/TUI, Ory identity, GitLab and Nexus.

spec.title: Developers
spec.description: Developer namespaces with at least one running workspace.

spec.title: Workspaces running
spec.description: Running workspace jobs (companion databases excluded).

spec.title: Companion DBs
spec.description: Running *-db companion jobs.

spec.title: Workspace CPU
spec.description: Cores in use by every task of the selected workspaces.

spec.title: Workspace memory
spec.description: Memory in use by the selected workspaces and companions.

spec.title: Memory vs reservation
spec.description: Used / reserved memory over the selected workspaces.

spec.title: SSH sessions
spec.description: Open bastion → workspace connections (sm-jump).

spec.title: Web connections
spec.description: Open Traefik → workspace connections (browser IDE).

spec.title: Workspace connect failures
spec.description: Bastion or Traefik failing to reach a workspace (stopped workspace or denied intention).

spec.title: Onboarding 5xx ratio
spec.description: Portal, TUI and Oathkeeper inbound 5xx share.

spec.title: Identity 5xx ratio
spec.description: Kratos, Hydra and login-consent inbound 5xx share.

spec.title: Default-pool memory free
spec.description: Unreserved memory in the default node pool, where workspaces are placed. A new workspace needs its reservation to fit on one node.

spec.title: CPU by workspace
spec.description: Cores used per workspace job (all tasks: IDE, git-broker, llm-broker, Envoy).

spec.title: Memory by workspace
spec.description: Memory used per workspace job.

spec.title: Memory vs reservation by task
spec.description: Above 100% a task runs on memory_max oversubscription and is first to be OOM-killed.

spec.title: Memory by task role
spec.description: Where workspace memory goes: the IDE container vs. the git/LLM brokers, companion databases and Envoy sidecars.

spec.title: CPU throttling by workspace
spec.description: CFS periods throttled. A developer hitting their CPU limit feels it as a sluggish IDE.

spec.title: Workspace placement
spec.description: Which client runs each workspace (value = task count).

spec.title: SSH sessions by workspace
spec.description: Active bastion connections per workspace.

spec.title: Web connections by workspace
spec.description: Active Traefik connections per workspace.

spec.title: Access throughput
spec.description: Bytes exchanged with workspaces through the bastion and Traefik.

spec.title: Inbound HTTP by plane
spec.description: Request load on onboarding, identity, GitLab, Nexus and ingress.

spec.title: 5xx by plane
spec.description: Server errors per plane.

spec.title: Onboarding p95 latency
spec.description: Portal, TUI and Oathkeeper request time.

spec.title: GitLab runners per developer (memory)
spec.description: Per-developer GitLab runner memory.
